audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows disagreed with the packet chart and with the page's own whys: win[0] said Skill while whys[0] says 'you concede the level and farm'; win[2] said Sion while whys[2] says the Q-W combo 'evens the trade'; win[4] said Skill while whys[4] calls level 6 'your one clear spike'; win[5] said Sion while whys[5] says the lane stays even.
audit.why: Sion's early is Roar of the Slayer poke from 800 range; K'Sante's answer arrives at 3 and peaks at 6 against an immobile target; Sion reclaims it on HP scaling.
audit.corrected: Level 1 = Sion (4/10), Level 3 = Skill, Level 6 = K'Sante (6/10), First item = Skill, all in matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Lvl 1-2 (his poke), Lvl 3 (your combo), Lvl 6 (All Out), 2+ items (his HP scaling) are the right four beats.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three errors. (a) Roar of the Slayer was called 'E shield-break poke' in four places — Riot's text says it damages, slows and REDUCES ARMOR, and knocks a minion back through enemies; there is no shield-break. (b) Soul Furnace was called a channel that 'roots him in place' — it is a self-shield that he can reactivate 3 seconds later, and it does not lock him down. (c) 'All Out's dash-through survives his charged Q knockup' asserts a displacement immunity that is nowhere in Riot's text.
audit.why: The armour shred matters: it makes his poke compound with his follow-up, and it is the reason raw armour stacking reads worse here than it looks. Believing his W roots him invites a commit into a shield plus a delayed AoE detonation.
audit.corrected: Armour shred named with its 800 range, the W reactivate stated as a 3-second timer, and the level-6 spike re-grounded on Decimating Smash being slow and telegraphed rather than an invented dash immunity.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither missing interaction was on the page: Glory in Death heals him off max-health attacks, and Glory in Death plus Soul Furnace both deal max-health damage, so stacking resistances is the wrong response.
audit.why: Percent-max-health damage ignores how much armour you bought, and his passive sustain wins any grind unless Grievous Wounds is applied.
audit.corrected: Both written into whys[6], spikes[3], late and wants.foe[2].

edits.before: Sion owns the first two levels here — his E shield-break poke hits from outside your short Q range and you have no engage threat at Level 1 with only Q, so just farm and eat a little chip. Do NOT walk in to throw a single Q stack into his E poke; you lose that exchange every time. The lane turns at Level 3 when your full Q-W combo comes online: if he steps up or starts charging a Q, W into him to negate the knockup and Q3 to knock him up yourself.

Do NOT walk in to throw a single Q stack into that poke; you lose the exchange every time. The lane turns at Level 3 when your full Q-W combo comes online: if he steps up or starts charging a Q, W into him and Q3 to pull him back into your range.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are a genuine coinflip tank standoff — you trade around his charged Q and his W shield, banking small leads with your bulk, but he out-pokes you with E so don't over-extend on his wave. Level 6 is your window: All Out strips your tankiness but its dash-through survives his charged Q knockup, and against an immobile Sion you get a clean duelist 1v1 he can't escape. Bait his charged Q or his W channel — both root him in place — then commit your combo. If you don't bank a lead in this window, you have nothing on him later.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are a genuine coinflip tank standoff — you trade around his charged Q and his W shield, banking small leads with your bulk, but he out-pokes you with E so don't over-extend on his wave. Level 6 is your window: All Out strips your tankiness, but a fully-charged Decimating Smash is slow and telegraphed, and against an immobile Sion you get a clean duelist 1v1 he can't escape. Bait the charge, then commit — and count 3 seconds off his Soul Furnace shield, because that is when the reactivate detonates.

edits.before: This is where the lane slips away. Sion is a pure scaling tank with a zombie passive and raw HP that your armor stacking does nothing to crack — once he's two items deep he just out-bulks you, out-utilities you in teamfights with his charged Q engage, and refuses to die. Your R lets you peel a carry, but in a straight tank-vs-tank attrition fight he wins. Close on your Level 3-and-6 windows and translate any lead to the map; do not bet on out-scaling him late.
edits.after: This is where the lane slips away. Sion scales on raw HP, and both Glory in Death and Soul Furnace deal max-health damage, so armour is the wrong answer and Grievous Wounds is the right one. Two items deep he out-bulks you, out-utilities you in teamfights with his charged Q engage, and refuses to die. Your R lets you peel a carry, but in a straight tank-vs-tank attrition fight he wins. Close on your Level 3-and-6 windows; do not bet on out-scaling him late.
